Summary KPIs

Attainment and Progress

Subjects
Rating guide

Attainment bands

Mainstream, Gifted and Talented: below 50% Below; 50–69% In line; 70%+ Above Expectation.

SoD/PoD: below 31% Below; 31–70% In line; 71%+ Above.

Each student is banded with their own group's thresholds. At least in line includes Above.

Attainment judgment

  • Outstanding: 75%+ Above
  • Very Good: 75%+ In line and 61–74% Above
  • Good: 75%+ In line and 50–60% Above
  • Acceptable: 75%+ In line, under 50% Above
  • Weak: 16–74% In line
  • Very Weak: 0–15% In line

Progress rating

Same subject across two exams in ten-point bands (0–10, 11–20 … 91–100). Better: end band higher, or both 91–100. Expected: same band. Weak: lower.

  • Outstanding: 75%+ Better
  • Very Good: 75%+ Expected-or-Better and 61–74% Better
  • Good: 75%+ Expected-or-Better and 50–60% Better
  • Acceptable: 75%+ Expected-or-Better, under 50% Better
  • Weak: 16–74%
  • Very Weak: 0–15%

Achiever groups use the start-exam score: High above 85%, Low below 40%.

Inclusion triangulation

Internal results for SoD/PoD, Gifted, Talented and Under Observation students.
The Under Observation exam selector controls UOB membership (mean across scored subjects ≤ 32%). Score columns show each student's mean across subjects for every exam in the selected academic year; blank means no matched score for that year. Students in several categories appear once. Learning plans are not in the files supplied, so all show as not recorded.
